items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: I know the Korns, Marcus and Navi, Korn. ... Marty, Marty played Paranet. Marcus played Trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah. I've heard him talk about the harmony band, you know. Yeah. He had that band. Yeah. Do you know any of the Rosenmeier's? No. Rosenmeier? Rosenmeier, I think they've worked for him. No, I don't.
I know the Korns, Marcus and Navi, Korn. What did they play? Trombone and Paranet. Marty, Marty played Paranet. Marcus played Trombone.
I see. And how did they sound? Did they work with you? They put my earmorphs? Yeah,
